name: Centaur Bounty
summary: At Nijel's Point, Corporal Melkins sends you after Desolace's centaur clans. He asks for fifteen ears, believing peace cannot come while they remain.

sections.title: One Thing in Common
sections.body: At Nijel's Point, Corporal Melkins speaks of Desolace's centaur clans. Each has its own leader and plans. Yet all share the same cruelty. Melkins says peace can come only when the centaur are gone.

sections.title: Ears for the Alliance
sections.body: As you wander Desolace, you hunt centaur and take their ears. Melkins asks you to bring fifteen. He calls this service to the Alliance, bringing the war's end nearer.

faq.q: Who issues the bounty on the centaur?
faq.answer: Corporal Melkins issues the bounty from Nijel's Point in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Corporal Melkins want the centaur killed?
faq.answer: Melkins says the clans differ in their leaders and aims, but all are cruel. He believes peace is impossible while the centaur remain.

faq.q: What does Corporal Melkins ask you to bring?
faq.answer: Melkins asks you to bring fifteen centaur ears, taken from those you hunt while wandering Desolace.

faq.q: Which centaur clans need to be hunted?
faq.answer: Melkins names no single clan. He says all the clans share cruelty and asks you to hunt centaur in Desolace.
